title: CE31002: Foundation Engineering
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction, examples of foundation problems, site characterization, site
investigation methods, in situ tests, bearing capacity - general, local and
punching shear failure, effect of size, shape, depth and water table,
settlement of foundations - elastic, consolidation and total settlement; stress
distribution in soil, types of foundation â shallow/deep, isolated, combined,
mat etc., contact pressure distribution, basics of design of shallow
foundation, deep foundation â type, load transfer mechanism in piles, pile
capacity, laterally loaded pile, test pile and pile load test, efficiency of
pile group, settlement of pile, stability analysis of different earth retaining
structures â gravity, cantilever, counterfort, reinforced earth etc, ground
improvement methods.
